title: Zhou et al. (2026): Photometric Variability and Rotation of beta Pictoris b from JWST NIRCam Coronagraphic Imaging

evidence.locator: Abstract and Section 5: JWST programme 4758, 21-22 March 2025, F210M and F410M behind MASK335R over 16.2 h; rotation period 9.00 +/- 0.13 h with amplitudes 0.85 and 0.89%; spin axis inclination consistent with 90 degrees, no misalignment with the orbit
